nurse.text: Medical Room. Welcome. Everyone here does a first aid course, but I'm the one with the stethoscope and the good biscuits.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Lie down, put your feet up. The team can go on the warm shelf, by the autoclave. They will be fine in a minute.
All done. Warm as toast. And it's not even midwinter.
The Ark's in the cupboard. We call it the Ark, not the Freezer, though it's in the freezer room.

else.text: No trouble. The door's always open. It's a very heavy door.
